title: Coaches
heading: Your coaches
nothing: Nothing from your profile right now.
endedNote: An ended relationship can’t be restarted. A coach you worked with keeps only the dates and your name at the end.

active.title: No coaches yet
active.body: A coach appears here once you accept their invitation. Nothing is shared with anyone until you do.

ended.title: No ended relationships
ended.body: Relationships you or a coach end are listed here, with the dates only.

unavailable.title: Coaches aren’t available
unavailable.body: Finish your fighter profile to see the coaches you work with.

failed.title: We couldn’t load your coaches.
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

never.title: Never shared with coaches
never.account: Account name, date of birth and email
never.others: Anything you share with other coaches

howTo: Coaches connect by invitation: open the link in their email to review and accept.

end.title: End your relationship with {name}?
end.body: {name} stops seeing your profile at once. To work together again, they have to send you a new invitation.
end.failed: We couldn’t end the relationship. Nothing changed. Try again.
end.unavailable: This relationship is no longer available. Your coaches list is up to date.
